1.text: Yakobo yumva yuko ubuhashyi buri muri Egiputa abaza abana be ati “Ni iki gituma murebana?”

2.text: Kandi ati “Numvise yuko hari ubuhashyi muri Egiputa, nimumanuke mujyeyo muduhahireyo tubeho tudapfa.”

3.text: Bene se wa Yosefu cumi baramanuka, bajya guhaha imyaka y'impeke muri Egiputa.

4.text: Ariko Benyamini mwene nyina wa Yosefu, Yakobo ntiyamutumana na bene se, kuko yibwiraga ati “Ahari yagira ibyago.”

5.text: Abana ba Isirayeli bajya guhahana n'abandi, kuko inzara yateye mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni.

6.text: Kandi Yosefu ni we wari umutware w'igihugu cya Egiputa, ni we wahahishaga abo muri icyo gihugu bose. Bene se wa Yosefu baraza, bamwikubita imbere bubamye.

7.text: Yosefu abona bene se arabamenya, arabirengagiza, ababwira nabi. Arababaza ati “Murava he?”Baramusubiza bati “Turava mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni tuje guhaha.”

8.text: Yosefu amenya bene se ariko bo ntibamumenya.

9.text: Yosefu yibuka za nzozi yabaroteye arababwira ati “Muri abatasi muje gutata aho igihugu gifite amaboko make.”

10.text: Baramusubiza bati “Si ko biri databuja, ahubwo abagaragu bawe tuzanywe no guhaha.

11.text: Twese tuva inda imwe, turi abanyakuri, abagaragu bawe ntituri abatasi.”

12.text: Arababwira ati “Si ko biri, ahubwo gutata aho igihugu gifite amaboko make ni ko kubazanye.”

13.text: Baramusubiza bati “Abagaragu bawe turi abavandimwe turi cumi na babiri, turi abana b'umwe wo mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni, umuhererezi yasigaranye na data, undi ntakiriho.”

14.text: Yosefu arababwira ati “Icyo ni cyo nababwiye nti ‘Muri abatasi.’

15.text: Iki ni cyo kizabahakanira: ndahiye ubugingo bwa Farawo, ntimuzava hano umuhererezi wanyu ataje.

16.text: Mutume umwe muri mwe azane murumuna wanyu, namwe murabohwa, amagambo yanyu ageragezwe yuko muri abanyakuri. Nibitaba bityo, ndahiye ubugingo bwa Farawo, muri abatasi.”

17.text: Bose abamaza mu nzu y'imbohe iminsi itatu.

18.text: Ku munsi wa gatatu Yosefu arababwira ati “Mugenze mutya mudapfa kuko nubaha Imana:

19.text: niba muri abanyakuri umwe muri mwe abavandimwe, asigare abohewe mu nzu yanyu y'imbohe, abandi mugende mujyane imyaka y'impeke yo kubamara inzara mu ngo zanyu,

20.text: maze munzanire umuhererezi wanyu. Ni ho amagambo yanyu azamenyekana ko ari ay'ukuri, bigatuma mudapfa.”Bagenza batyo.

21.text: Baravugana bati “Ni ukuri turiho urubanza rw'ibyo twagiriye mwene data, kuko twabonye uko umutima we wari ubabaye ubwo yatwingingaga natwe ntitumwumvire, ni byo biduteye aya makuba.”

22.text: Rubeni arababwira ati “Sinababwiye nti, mwe gukora icyaha kuri uwo mwana mukanga kunyumvira? Ni cyo gitumye amaraso ye adushakirwaho.”

23.text: Ntibamenya yuko Yosefu yumva ibyo bavuga, kuko yavugirwaga n'umusemyi.

24.text: Abatera umugongo abasiga aho ararira, abagarukaho avugana na bo, abakuramo Simiyoni, amubohera mu maso yabo.

25.text: Yosefu ategeka ko babuzuriza imyaka y'impeke mu masaho yabo, kandi ngo basubize ifeza y'umuntu wese mu isaho ye, kandi babahe n'impamba. Babagirira batyo.

26.text: Bahekesha indogobe zabo ihaho ryabo, bavayo.

27.text: Aho baraye, umwe muri bo ahambuye isaho ye ngo agaburire indogobe ye, abona ifeza ye, asanga iri mu munwa w'isaho.

28.text: Abwira bene se ati “Ifeza yanjye irangarukiye, dore iri mu isaho yanjye.” Bakuka imitima, barebana bahinda imishyitsi bati “Ibi ni ibiki, ibyo Imana itugiriye?”

29.text: Basohora kuri se Yakobo mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni, bamubwira ibyababayeho byose bati

30.text: “Umugabo ukomeye utwara icyo gihugu, yatubwiye nabi akeka yuko turi abatasi babatata.

31.text: Natwe turamubwira tuti ‘Turi abanyakuri, ntituri abatasi.

32.text: Turi abavandimwe turi cumi na babiri dusangiye data umwe, umwe ntakiriho, umuhererezi yasigaranye na data mu gihugu cy'i Kanāni.’

33.text: Uwo mugabo ukomeye utwara icyo gihugu aratubwira ati ‘Iki ni cyo kizambwira ko muri abanyakuri: nimunsigire umwe muri mwe abavandimwe, mujyane ibyo kubamara inzara mu ngo zanyu, mugende

34.text: munzanire umuhererezi wanyu. Ni ho nzamenya yuko mutari abatasi, ahubwo ko muri abanyakuri, nanjye nzabaha mwene so kandi muzatunda mu gihugu.’ ”

35.text: Basutse ibyo mu masaho yabo babona igipfunyika cy'ifeza cy'umuntu wese kiri mu isaho ye, bo na se babonye ibipfunyika byabo baratinya.

36.text: Se Yakobo arababwira ati “Mungize incike: Yosefu ntakiriho, Simiyoni ntariho, none kandi murashaka kunkuraho na Benyamini! Ibyo ni jye bibayeho byose!”

37.text: Rubeni abwira se ati “Nintamukugarurira uzice abahungu banjye bombi, mumpe ndamwishingiye nzamukugarurira.”

38.text: Aramusubiza ati “Umwana wanjye ntazajyana namwe, kuko mwene nyina yapfuye akaba asigaye ari ikinege, yagirira ibyago mu nzira muzacamo, muzatuma imvi zanjye zimanukana ishavu zijya ikuzimu.”
